## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Update to an existing skill
- [ ] Category or index change
- [ ] Tooling or documentation
- [ ] Correction

## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/build-index.mjs` was run
- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes with zero errors
- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter `name` matches the folder name
- [ ] `description` says both what it does and when to use it
- [ ] `README.md` includes source/attribution and licence
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing skill (searched `SKILLS_INDEX.md`)
- [ ] Licence permits redistribution; attribution is accurate
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or machine-specific paths are included
- [ ] No instruction to hide behaviour from the user, exfiltrate data, or run unreviewed code
- [ ] `RUNNING.md` has an entry for this change
